*TRANSLATOR*

1. Reply to a message with: .translate <lang> or .trt <lang>
2. Or type: .translate <lang> <text> or .trt <lang> <text>

.trt fr hello

fr - French
es - Spanish
de - German
it - Italian
pt - Portuguese
ru - Russian
ja - Japanese
ko - Korean
zh - Chinese
ar - Arabic
